lines.trans: Mom, you do everything for my own good, right?
Wait, if you offered money to our cook Maxim...
Does that mean you could have offered it to Denis earlier too?
Tell me honestly, did Denis take the money back then?
In life we all look for a compromise one way or another.
In a relationship between a man and a woman, compromise is very important.
It carefully keeps our love afloat.
Forgive me that we celebrated our anniversary so absurdly.
You know, I actually enjoyed this evening!
Really? Then we will have to repeat it next year!

words.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

examples.text: Прости, дорогой, тут я бессилен помочь.
examples.trans: Sorry, my friend, here I am powerless to help.

examples.text: Простите, пожалуйста, а как насчёт моей работы?
examples.trans: Excuse me, please, what about my job?

examples.text: Катя, прости, просто мне очень нужны были деньги.
examples.trans: Katya, forgive me, I just needed the money very badly.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'лепо'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Прости, что так нелепо отпраздновали нашу годовщину.
examples.trans: Forgive me that we celebrated our anniversary so absurdly.

examples.text: Костя сказал это совершенно нелепо и спокойно.
examples.trans: Kostya said this quite absurdly and calmly.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'праздновать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'celebrate'.

examples.text: Мы же хотели отпраздновать этот день вместе.
examples.trans: We wanted to celebrate this day together.

examples.text: Прости, что так нелепо отпраздновали нашу годовщину.
examples.trans: Forgive me that we celebrated our anniversary so absurdly.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'anniversary' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Спасибо, дорогая, поздравляю нас с годовщиной!

examples.text: Прости, что так нелепо отпраздновали нашу годовщину.
examples.trans: Forgive me that we celebrated our anniversary so absurdly.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'know'.

examples.text: Это мне вчера знакомый из банка принёс.

examples.trans: A friend got us one more ticket right next to yours!

examples.text: Извини, Миша, я правда не знал этого.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to me', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'even', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Как тебе это удалось? Их нет в продаже!
examples.trans: How did you manage that? They are sold out!

examples.text: Даже огромного зверя достать сейчас гораздо проще!
examples.trans: Even getting a giant beast is much easier right now!

examples.text: Здорово-то как, я просто даже не ожидал!
examples.trans: How wonderful, I simply did not even expect that!

meanings.en: to be liked, to make a good impression
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нравиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'pleased', paired with 'нравиться'.

examples.text: Синеозерск понравился в Москве больше других мест.
examples.trans: In Moscow they liked Sineozersk more than other places.

examples.text: Тебе понравился фильм?
examples.trans: Did you like the film?

examples.text: Не бойся, тебе понравится.
examples.trans: Don't be afraid, you'll like it.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'егодняшний'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('today's').

examples.text: Я хорошо подумал над вашим сегодняшним предложением.
examples.trans: I thought carefully about your offer today.

examples.text: Знаешь, а мне даже понравился сегодняшний вечер!
examples.trans: You know, I actually enjoyed this evening!

examples.text: Мне очень понравился сегодняшний вечер!
examples.trans: I really enjoyed this evening!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'really', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to go over again', paired with 'повторять'.

examples.text: Правда? Тогда надо будет повторить на следующий год!
examples.trans: Really? Then we will have to repeat it next year!

examples.text: Так, давай повторим.
examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.

examples.text: Повторите, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Repeat that, please.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ледующий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('next').

examples.text: Ну, сходим на футбол в следующий раз.

examples.text: Сходим на футбол в следующий раз.
examples.trans: We will go to football next time.

examples.text: Правда? Тогда надо будет повторить на следующий год!
examples.trans: Really? Then we will have to repeat it next year!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'let (them)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.
